main_text.p: Ɛgislikts, Terribilis: & Ɛgisliko, Terribiliter: nos Ɛisseltk] Omnes istæ quatuor voces eandem, ut verisimile est, sapiunt originem cum Saxon. ezḝ, timor, & ezḝlic, terribilis, quibus etiam terriculamenta ezḝezṗimma 7 Inde forte Larva eis hazerṗe, hazterṗe, vulgò hodie a bagge.

Ɛdwlt, Opprobrium] Eodem sensu Sax. eopiᵴ, & seopiᵴ, quod ab eorum stᵴpitan fluens, imputare, exprobrare, sonat; unde nostrum twtting, ut alicui in aliquo exprobrare, vulgò dicimus, to twtt one with this of that.
Ɛino, Solus] Hoc Sax. ana, de quo velim consulas Spelmanni nostri Glossar.in voce An.

Ɛinodis, Solitudinis: & Ɛinods, Solitudine] Compositum reor à præcedenti Ɛino, & adjectitiâ particulâ, bod, ut olim scriptum, postea bepd,belt, bat; Sax. haoe, nobis bood, i.e. genus, conditio, qualitas, status, ut pluribus à me alibi ostensum, in Tractatu de Ɛabelkinɒ, nondum edito, cap. 4. Ɛinod itaque

page.notes: Black letter words rendered approximately; Greek-looking Old English/Saxon glosses in the original are printed in a mix of Gothic and Greek-like forms; several words are doubtful and marked only by this note. The bottom of the page carries faint marks and show-through, not transcribed.
